rows.name: DokuWiki with Tag plugin
rows.reason: DokuWiki/Tag offers PHP pages, categories and access controls for restricted FAQ authoring. Storage departs from MySQL; organization/keywords need configuration. Attachment, Windows and SSO workflows remain unverified after retrieval failure.

rows.name: PBS FAQ
rows.reason: The supplied page was inaccessible and two primary-domain searches did not locate the product; its PHP/MySQL stack, price, attachments, access controls, and Windows compatibility remain unverified.

rows.name: DokuWiki (wiki-based alternative requiring verification)
rows.reason: DokuWiki remains an unverified alternative, not a ready recommendation: blocked docs establish neither Windows compatibility, cost, keyword/categories, attachments, anonymous reading nor editing controls.

rows.name: HESK knowledge-base-only mode
rows.reason: Free PHP KB-only mode offers public searchable articles, categories, attachments and keywords within a help-desk suite. Windows/IIS, staff editing, SSO, small-corpus search and comparative performance unverified.

rows.name: OpenPBS
rows.reason: OpenPBS manages HPC jobs and clusters, not FAQ/knowledgebase content. This documented application-scope mismatch does not infer unsupported features or Windows incompatibility.

rows.name: OpenPBS
rows.reason: The official repository identifies an HPC workload manager and job scheduler; it does not supply the FAQ articles, keywords, categories, attachments, or public browsing application requested.

rows.name: PBS FAQ
rows.reason: PBS FAQ remains unverified: official article inaccessible; license, Windows setup, metadata/attachments and access controls unestablished. Access failure is not evidence of incompatibility.

rows.name: phpMyFAQ
rows.reason: PhpMyFAQ repeats the installed, rejected engine; no changed configuration resolving complaints was verified. Version 4.2 news postdates question. This does not assert missing fields or access controls.

rows.name: phpMyFAQ
rows.reason: The question explicitly seeks a replacement for this already-installed product because of speed, defects, and excess features; its matching FAQ capabilities do not address that stated rejection.

rows.name: HESK in knowledgebase-only mode
rows.reason: Free Windows PHP/MySQL KB-only application documents requested fields/attachments, public reading and staff editing. Help-desk suite; SSO unverified; speed/defects/migration/usability untested. Avoid customer-account option hiding the entire help desk.

rows.name: PHPKB (self-hosted Standard edition candidate)
rows.reason: Windows PHP/MySQL knowledgebase; advertised self-hosted one-off minimum USD 285. Selected-edition affordability and keyword field unresolved; SSO depends on edition/add-ons. Complexity may conflict with simplicity preference.

rows.name: LibreKB
rows.reason: Free PHP/MySQL articles with categories, controlled editing and attachments. Keyword field and SSO unverified; search covers title/body. Check Windows compatibility with PHP 8.4 and .htaccess-style rewriting.
